dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: People still use Mora in commercial transactions, I assume?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, same as ever. Just as shiny, and just as hypnotic!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second. Ei... are you saying you don't have any Mora either?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Of course I don't. There is no need for commerce in the Plane of Euthymia. If I ever need something, I can simply have one of the Commissions bring it to me.
